## Problem

What limitation or use case should be addressed?

## Proposed change

Describe the smallest useful implementation.

## Architecture impact

Which modules or interfaces would change?

## Validation

How should the change be tested in software and, when relevant, on the robot?

## Scope accuracy

Does the proposal introduce mapping, planning, tracking, or obstacle avoidance? State exactly what will and will not be implemented.
